annotations.title: Read Google Local Services Ads leads

description: The calls, messages and bookings a Google Local Services campaign produced, newest first: type, status, whether Google charged for it, the consumer's name and phone, category. Filter by fromDate / toDate (YYYY-MM-DD), leadType, leadStatus, chargedOnly. Pass leadId for that lead's conversation (calls with duration and recording link, messages with text). Read-only, free. These are the advertiser's own leads and contain personal details: show them to the user who asked.

customerId.description: Google Ads account id, 10 digits (dashes ok); omit for the brand's default account

leadStatus.description: NEW, ACTIVE, BOOKED, DECLINED, EXPIRED, DISABLED, CONSUMER_DECLINED or WIPED_OUT

loginCustomerId.description: manager (MCC) account id, when the account is managed through one
